messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
投擲後，球的加速度不會因為初速度而改變。  
在忽略空氣阻力的情況下，重力提供的加速度始終是

\[
a = -g \approx -9.8 \ \text{m/s}^2
\]

（負號表示方向向下）。  
因此，無論球以 5 m/s 向上投擲，或以任何其他速度投擲，球在空中受到的加速度始終是約 \(-9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\)。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want the acceleration? Actually they might be asking what acceleration it will reach? But acceleration is constant due to gravity: -9.8 m/s^2 downward. The initial velocity is 5 m/s upward. The acceleration due to gravity is constant. So answer: -9.8 m/s^2 downward. They might want to compute maximum height? But question: "它將達到什麼加速度？" Means "what acceleration will it reach?" The acceleration is constant -9.8 m/s^2 downward. So answer accordingly. No function call needed.
